findings.claim: The builder dropped 15 lane reviews from layers 0-9 because it joins lane entries to cards on the exact repository string. Cards whose repository URL has a /releases/tag/... or /tree/... suffix never match the lane's plain repository URL, so they are published as not_individually_reviewed with empty evidence and no why_selected or overturn. Some of the lost reviews had been adversarially verified: codex-for-claude unmaintained_signal, mcporter pin_behind_upstream with a security-relevant v0.14.0 note, and markitdown pin_behind_upstream. Each of those proposals had two votes with refuted=false.

Examples: manifest foundation[2].components[3] codex-for-claude has repository "https://github.com/openai/codex-plugin-cc/tree/v1.0.6", review_status "not_individually_reviewed" and evidence [], while the lanes.json foundation lane (workers) has repository "https://github.com/openai/codex-plugin-cc" and status "unmaintained_signal". foundation[4].components[4] mcporter has ".../openclaw/mcporter/tree/v0.13.13" against lane status "pin_behind_upstream". foundation[5].components[1] markitdown has ".../releases/tag/v0.1.7" against lane status "pin_behind_upstream". qmd/rtk in native-clients (lane: confirmed_default) and ast-grep, codebase-memory-mcp, repomix, toon, agent-browser, plus qmd/repomix/rtk/toon in token-efficiency (lane: confirmed_conditional) are affected the same way. findings.claim: Redaction keeps only the basename for citations into the repository checkout, so different files collapse to the same token and cannot be resolved.
findings.evidence: build_manifest.py lines 389-394: `basename = _path_basename(path_part)` ... `return f"{token}/{basename}"`. lanes.json cites blueprints/us-equities/broad-universe/README.md (data-alpaca-py, data-duckdb) and catalogs/us-equities/README.md (quantstats, vllm). Both appear in the manifest as '<host-path>/README.md'. The file's own docstring (lines 359-362) names this failure mode: 'the reader can no longer tell which of hundreds of files under the redacted directory a citation named'.
findings.fix: Pass the checkout root to sanitize(). For matches under the checkout, emit the path relative to the repository (for example blueprints/us-equities/broad-universe/README.md). Keep <host-path>/<basename> only for paths outside the checkout and the work dir. Add a test with two same-basename citations.
